"""
A_f = 1/2 sqrt((a_f+(b_f+c_f)) (c_f-(a_f-b_f)) (c_f+(a_f-b_f)) (a_f+(b_f-c_f)))
C_f = 1/(4 A_f) [b_f²+c_f²-a_f², c_f²+a_f²-b_f², a_f²+b_f²-c_f²]

where

a_i ∈ ℝ
b_i ∈ ℝ
c_i ∈ ℝ

"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, a, b, c):
        a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)
        b = np.asarray(b, dtype=np.float64)
        c = np.asarray(c, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = a.shape[0]
        assert a.shape == (dim_0,)
        assert b.shape == (dim_0,)
        assert c.shape == (dim_0,)
        # A_f = 1/2 sqrt((a_f+(b_f+c_f)) (c_f-(a_f-b_f)) (c_f+(a_f-b_f)) (a_f+(b_f-c_f)))
        self.A = np.zeros(dim_0)
        for f in range(1, dim_0+1):
            self.A[f-1] = (1) / (2) * np.sqrt((a[f-1] + (b[f-1] + c[f-1])) * (c[f-1] - (a[f-1] - b[f-1])) * (c[f-1] + (a[f-1] - b[f-1])) * (a[f-1] + (b[f-1] - c[f-1])))
        # C_f = 1/(4 A_f) [b_f²+c_f²-a_f², c_f²+a_f²-b_f², a_f²+b_f²-c_f²]
        self.C = np.zeros((dim_0, 1, 3))
        for f in range(1, dim_0+1):
            C_f_0 = np.zeros((1, 3))
            C_f_0[0] = [np.power(np.asarray(b[f-1], dtype=np.float64), 2) + np.power(np.asarray(c[f-1], dtype=np.float64), 2) - np.power(np.asarray(a[f-1], dtype=np.float64), 2), np.power(np.asarray(c[f-1], dtype=np.float64), 2) + np.power(np.asarray(a[f-1], dtype=np.float64), 2) - np.power(np.asarray(b[f-1], dtype=np.float64), 2), np.power(np.asarray(a[f-1], dtype=np.float64), 2) + np.power(np.asarray(b[f-1], dtype=np.float64), 2) - np.power(np.asarray(c[f-1], dtype=np.float64), 2)]
            self.C[f-1] = (1) / ((4 * self.A[f-1])) * C_f_0
